Thanks — I reviewed the attached logs and ran a quick eval on prefix/cache behavior. Notes: 

- The recommendation flow has a low KV-cache hit rate (~45%), so identical prefixes are frequently recomputed; enabling a short-lived prefix cache would cut token re-gen by ~18–22% for that endpoint.
- We observe slightly higher transformer decode times for sequences >512 tokens; quantizing model variants for the long-tail requests can reduce cost with minimal quality loss.
- Error rates are flat; most latency is tail-only under concurrent bursts.

Recommendation (technical):
1) Short-term: enable prefix caching + a 15% routing shift to a slightly cheaper model variant for non-personalized recommendations. This gets you ~20–25% unit cost reduction without a capacity commit.
2) Medium-term: reserve +30% capacity on Dedicated for p95 targets and predictable routing — recommended if you need consistent p95 below 400ms during peak.

I can prepare an ROI slide showing expected monthly token cost delta for both options — will attach to the call notes.

— Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
